title: Search Me, O God, and Know My Heart

questions.question: O Lord, you have searched me and known whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:1 (ESV): "O Lord, you have searched me and known me!"

questions.question: You know when I sit down and when I do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:2 (ESV): "You know when I sit down and when I rise up;"

questions.question: You discern my thoughts from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:2 (ESV): "you discern my thoughts from afar."

questions.question: You search out my path and my lying down and are acquainted with all my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:3 (ESV): "and are acquainted with all my ways."

questions.question: Even before a word is on my tongue, behold, O Lord, you know it how?
You hem me in, behind and before, and lay your hand upon whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:5 (ESV): "and lay your hand upon me."

questions.question: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high; I cannot do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:6 (ESV): "it is high; I cannot attain it."

questions.question: Where shall I go from your Spirit? Or where shall I flee from your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:7 (ESV): "Or where shall I flee from your presence?"

questions.question: If I ascend to heaven, you are there! If I make my bed in Sheol, what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:8 (ESV): "If I make my bed in Sheol, you are there!"

questions.question: For you formed my inward parts; you knitted me together in my mother's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:13 (ESV): "you knitted me together in my mother's womb."

questions.question: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:14 (ESV): "I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made."

questions.question: My frame was not hidden from you, when I was being made in secret, intricately woven in the depths of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:15 (ESV): "intricately woven in the depths of the earth."

questions.question: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in your book were written, every one of them, the days that were formed for me, when as yet there was what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:16 (ESV): "when as yet there was none of them."

questions.question: Search me, O God, and know my heart! Try me and know my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:23 (ESV): "Try me and know my thoughts!"

questions.question: And see if there be any grievous way in me, and lead me in the way what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 139:24 (ESV): "and lead me in the way everlasting!"

key_verse_text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Wonderful are your works; my soul knows it very well.
